“Workers read from a secret script to hide that they were human.” Remove the unsupported script and concealment details; if retaining the point, state only that trained human contract staff handled some calls in a test. Fact: MUSE-HC-006.
“About 40% of Muse calls were made by humans.” Replace the unsupported call percentage with the Ledger’s narrower scope: human contract staff handled some calls in a test. Fact: MUSE-HC-006.
